description: Opienka, a living cluster of honey fungus, a tall clump of golden-brown mushrooms with scaly caps growing from one thick base, glowing pale green foxfire light, long black root-like bootlaces lashing out like whips, small glowing eyes under the caps, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, eerie and menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the fungus alone, no tree, no ground, no background, the whole fungus inside the picture
